messages:
oliver: Thanks for the all-hands—quick security follow-ups from customers: SOC2/ISO status, VPC private control plane specifics (peering & endpoints), audit log field-level redaction, and KMS/BYOK rotation. Who can share short answers + owners?

security-bot: Slides + trackers uploaded: https://handbook.redwood.com/security/compliance. Office-hours sign-up: https://cal.com/redwood/security-officehours.

naomi: Short answers: SOC2 Type II window targeted Oct 2026 (controls in-place by Aug). ISO 27001 readiness assessment Q3, cert target H1 2027. VPC private control plane beta starting mid-June for selected customers; features: VPC endpoints, cross-account peering, and private DNS.

ryan: Audit logs: v1 schema includes model_id, model_version, request_id, route, token_in, token_out, latency_ms, and actor_id. Hosted default: prompt_text redacted/truncated in Console exports; retention 90 days. Private: customers can export full payloads to their own storage and control retention. Example event: ```{"ts":"2026-08-01T14:01:02Z","service":"inference","model_id":"redwood-7b-quant","model_version":"v1.2","request_id":"req_0F12"}```

julie: KMS: Private supports customer-managed KMS today (AWS/GCP/Azure). Envelope encryption used. Key rotation supported via customer KMS; we'll publish a rotation guide. HSM/BYOK (FIPS/HSM) planned alpha in Q4. Note: rotating keys requires coordinating cache re-encryption for long-lived artifacts.

infra-miguel: Networking note: cross-account peering in beta requires a peering connector and an IAM trust setup. We'll publish a checklist in the beta docs with required routes and security group advice. Also watch bandwidth egress costs across regions.

oliver: Action items I captured: (1) Publish SOC2/ISO timeline + controls mapping (owner: @naomi), (2) Publish audit-log schema + sample exports + ingest recipes (owner: @ryan), (3) KMS rotation guide + HSM roadmap (owner: @julie), (4) VPC beta networking checklist (owner: @infra-miguel), (5) 60-min office hours for customers + SREs (owner: security-bot).

security-bot: Created tasks and will ping owners tomorrow at 16:00 UTC.

ryan: Quick follow-up question from infra: will we include model_hash / quant_profile in logs for exact repro? roadmap for schema v2 includes model_hash and quant_profile.

julie: For BYOK, we will document the exact rekey steps and expected downtime/latency impacts. Will call out consequences for KV caches.

oliver: Great. Can we get a 1-pager for sales/solutions with dos and don'ts for customers asking now? If so, DM me and I'll coordinate.

naomi: Will prepare a short customer-facing FAQ + 1-pager and post by EOD tomorrow.

oliver: Thanks all. If anyone else has immediate questions drop them here and we'll cover in office hours.
